# ChipForge presets

Presets live in `chipforge/presets.yml`. Melodic presets have a `voice` (or a `stack` of voices); kit presets have `pieces` keyed by a lane letter or a hit name. Mix values are the tuned reference levels; a channel's `vol` multiplies them.

## arp

| preset | voice(s) | mix | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `arp.fm_pluck` | fm | vol 0.1, echo 0.3, pan 0.3 | Short FM pluck for arpeggios. |
| `arp.gb_pulse` | pulse | vol 0.09, pan 0.3 | 12.5% pulse arp voice for Game Boy songs. |
| `arp.pulse12` | pulse | vol 0.1, pan 0.3 | Fast 12.5% pulse arpeggio voice; plays chord tones at 60 Hz frame rate via the arp generator. |
| `arp.pulse25` | pulse | vol 0.06, pan 0.3, lp 2400 | 25% pulse arp; fuller than pulse12. |
| `arp.sid_pulse` | sid | vol 0.09, pan 0.3 | Thin SID pulse arp with a bright band-pass peak. |
| `arp.tri` | tri | vol 0.22, pan -0.2 | Triangle arpeggio; soft bell-like roll under a pulse lead. |

## Voice parameters

### `pulse`

| param | default | description |
|---|---|---|
| `duty` | `0.5` | Pulse width 0.125 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 (NES) or any 0.05-0.95 |
| `pluck` | `None` | Duty used for the first 2 frames (attack flick), e.g. 0.125 |
| `att` | `0.0` | Attack seconds |
| `dec` | `0.12` | Decay seconds to sustain |
| `sus` | `0.72` | Sustain level 0-1 |
| `rel` | `0.07` | Release seconds after note end |
| `vib` | `0.0` | Vibrato depth in semitones (0 = off) |
| `vib_rate` | `5.8` | Vibrato Hz |
| `vib_delay` | `0.2` | Seconds before vibrato starts |
| `vib_ramp` | `0.25` | Seconds to reach full depth |
| `vib_min` | `0.25` | Vibrato only on notes longer than this (s) |
| `slide` | `0.06` | Portamento time in seconds for ~slides |
| `detune` | `0.0` | Second detuned oscillator mix 0-1 (enhanced only) |
| `arp_rate` | `1` | Frames per step for @arp macros |

### `tri`

| param | default | description |
|---|---|---|
| `rel` | `0.006` | Release fade seconds (NES triangle has no volume envelope) |
| `steps` | `32` | Wavetable steps (32 = NES, 0 = clean band-limited triangle) |
| `vib` | `0.0` | Vibrato depth in semitones |
| `vib_rate` | `5.5` | Vibrato Hz |
| `vib_delay` | `0.25` | Seconds before vibrato starts |
| `slide` | `0.06` | Portamento time (s) |
